t: Din charitz mayim shebben b' techumin
s: Din charitz mayim shebben b' techumin ubo b' seipim: charitz male mayim mekunnasim shehu ben b' techume shabbat, miqtzato bitchum ir zo umiqtzato bitchum ir acheret — shette haayarot asurot lemallot mimmennu, ap al pi shekkol echad memalle mittok techumo, lepi shekkol mah shehu bitchum hair eno qoneh shebita bimqomo lihyot lo mishsham alpayim lekol ruach, ella achar hair hu nigrar veqoneh shebita bair, veim hu besop techumah — en yakol lazuz mishsham ulechutz. Veim ken mayim ellu, chetzyam qanu shebita beir zo vechetzyam bezo, vehem mitorbim ellu beellu. Veen din mayim ellu kedin cheptze hepqer sheenam qonim shebita kelal, lepi shekkevan shehem semukim lair, daat anshe hair alehem, vahare hem kigshamim hassemukim lair shehem keragle anshe hair, kemo shennitbaer besimman shtz"z; veen bene techum zeh yekolim lemallot mittok techuman, mippene erub mayim shel techum acher. Vetzarik laasot mechitztza gaboah y' tepachim besop hattechumin shebbecharitz, lehabdil ben mayim lemayim. Vaapillu hi shel qanim semukim zeh lezeh pachot mig' tepachim, shehammayim meorabim ben qaneh lachabero; vaapillu hi teluya, sheenah maggaat ad qarqait hecharitz, shehammayim meorabim mittachteha — en bekak kelum, sheqqal hu sheheqellu bemayim, sheen tzarik raq sheyyihyu nirim kemubdalim, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"h vesha"v. Veim hammayim moshekim o nobeim — en tzarik shum tiqqun, sheenam qonim shebita kelal, vahare hem keragle hamemalle rishon, kemo shennitbaer besimman shtz"z:
Bor shel teben haomed ben shene techumin — ellu maakilin mikkan veellu maakilin mikkan, veen chosheshin shemma ellu yiqchu mittechum shel ellu:
